title: mail: Mailbox/get implementation
description:
Implement Mailbox/get method in crates/mail/src/mailbox/get.rs: accept ids list (or null for all), query article_numbers store for each group's (low, high, count), populate totalEmails from count, return list of Mailbox objects. #not-found list for unknown ids. Reuse ArticleNumberStore from usenet-ipfs-reader.

Why: clients call Mailbox/get to display a folder list; totalEmails count is required for folder-view rendering.

Acceptance: integration test: after posting one article to comp.test, Mailbox/get for comp.test returns totalEmails=1.
